observations.detail: The exact B1 base release predates the explicit B1a selector. Its exact Lekton command exits 2 before acquisition with ErrorV6 input.invalid_revision, empty stdout, and no store. The B1 runner therefore exits 2 on its first positive sample and publishes no report.

The exact B1a candidate selector completes the pinned Lekton R16 scan with exit 0, empty stderr, and publication. This proves the product-side 75,000 millisecond scan boundary accepts the observed extraction without changing graph family counts.
observations.wall_time_ns: not retained because the diagnostic shell timer overflowed; no latency claim is made

observations.detail: The B1 oracle hashes were copied from the historical pilot identity urn:codenoesis:pilot:lekton, while the active B1 corpus selects urn:codenoesis:benchmark:lekton:b1. The exact B1 candidate preserves all reviewed family counts but correctly emits repository-identity-bound hashes different from the frozen oracle. Changing either the corpus identity or oracle hashes exceeds issues #205 and #206.

smallest_decision: Ratify an honest first supporting B1 baseline and the repository-identity-correct Lekton semantic hashes before real baseline/candidate comparison.
